name: Super Programmatic SEO
author: Manuel Salazar Osorio

sections.description:
Super Programmatic SEO is a WordPress plugin that uses artificial intelligence to generate high-quality, SEO-optimized articles. The FREE version uses Groq AI for fast, free content generation. The PRO version offers multiple AI providers (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and more) plus professional images from Pexels API, making it perfect for content marketers, SEO agencies, and website owners looking to streamline their content creation process.

FREE Version Features

  • Easy Article Generator: Simple one-click article generation with just a topic/keyword
  • Campaign System: Automatically generate articles with campaigns (1 article every 30 minutes, up to 20/month)
  • 20 Articles Per Month: Generous free tier for testing and small projects
  • Groq AI Integration: Uses Groq’s free, ultra-fast AI for high-quality content generation
  • English Language: Articles generated in English
  • Company Branding: Incorporates your company details into generated articles
  • SEO Optimization: Built-in SEO best practices and optimization
  • Configuration Status: Built-in verification system to ensure all required APIs are configured
  • WordPress Integration: Seamlessly integrates with WordPress posts and categories
  • No Images in FREE: Focus on text content (images available in PRO version)

PRO Version Features (Upgrade Available)

  • 300 Articles Per Month: Up to 10 articles per day (following Google’s indexing best practices)
  • Multiple AI Providers: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Grok, Groq, and more
  • Professional Images: Automatic image integration from Pexels API
  • 11 Writing Styles: Formal, professional, conversational, ironic, extra funny, and more
  • 7 Languages: English, Spanish, Italian, French, Portuguese, German, and Romanian
  • Advanced Article Generator: Customizable content blocks and structure
  • EEAT Optimization: Enhanced E-A-T (Expertise, Authoritativeness, Trustworthiness) sections
  • FAQ Generation: Automatic FAQ sections for better SEO
  • Campaign Management: Organize and manage content campaigns
  • Priority Support: Direct access to our support team

External APIs Required

FREE Version:
* Groq API: For AI content generation (completely free, no credit card required)

PRO Version:
* AI Provider API: Choose from ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Grok, Groq, and more
* Pexels API: For high-quality stock images (optional)

Security Features

  • Nonce verification for all AJAX requests
  • User capability checks
  • Input sanitization and validation
  • Secure API key storage
  • Proper WordPress coding standards compliance

Perfect For

  • SEO agencies managing multiple clients
  • Content marketers looking to scale content production
  • Blog owners wanting consistent, high-quality content
  • Businesses needing localized content in multiple languages
  • Anyone wanting to leverage AI for content creation

Privacy Policy

This plugin processes data locally on your WordPress installation. API keys are stored securely in your WordPress database. Generated content and user data remain on your server.

FREE Version: We recommend reviewing Groq’s privacy policy for their AI service.

PRO Version: We recommend reviewing the privacy policies for your chosen AI provider (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, etc.) and Pexels for image services.

Support

For support, feature requests, or bug reports, please visit our support page at https://superprogrammaticseo.ai/support/

Upgrade to PRO

Unlock the full potential of Super Programmatic SEO:

  • 300 Articles Per Month: Up to 10 articles per day (following Google’s indexing best practices)
  • Multiple AI Providers: Choose from ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Grok, Groq, and more
  • Professional Images: Automatic image integration from Pexels API
  • 11 Writing Styles: Choose from formal, professional, conversational, ironic, and more
  • 7 Languages: Generate content in English, Spanish, Italian, French, Portuguese, German, and Romanian
  • Advanced Article Generator: Customizable content blocks and structure
  • E-E-A-T Optimization: Enhanced Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness, Trustworthiness sections
  • FAQ Generation: Automatic FAQ sections for better SEO
  • Campaign Management: Organize and manage content campaigns
  • Priority Support: Direct access to our support team

Upgrade Now: https://superprogrammaticseo.ai/pricing

Development

Contributing developers can find the plugin source code and contribute at: https://github.com/Padilla-Business-Consulting/super-programmatic-seo
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/super-programmatic-seo directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Navigate to ‘Super Programmatic SEO’ in your WordPress admin menu
  4. For FREE Version Setup:
    • Get your free Groq API key from https://console.groq.com/keys (no credit card required!)
    • Add your company details (Company Name and Products/Services are required)
    • Go to ‘Easy Article’ and start generating your first SEO-optimized article!
  5. For PRO Version Setup:
    • Configure your preferred AI provider (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, etc.)
    • Optionally add Pexels API key for automatic image integration
    • Access advanced features like multiple writing styles and languages

FREE Version: Generate up to 20 articles per month with Groq AI (completely free)
PRO Version: Generate up to 300 articles per month (10 per day) with multiple AI providers and advanced features
sections.faq:
Do I need API keys to use this plugin?

FREE Version: Yes, you need a Groq API key (completely free, no credit card required). Get it at https://console.groq.com/keys

PRO Version: Yes, you need an API key from your chosen AI provider (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Grok, or Groq). Optionally, add a Pexels API key for automatic image integration.

How much do the APIs cost?

API pricing varies by provider and changes frequently. We recommend visiting each platform for current pricing:

FREE Version: Groq API is currently completely free with no credit card required for the 20 articles/month limit.

PRO Version: Each AI provider (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Grok, Groq) has different pricing models. Visit their respective platforms for up-to-date pricing. Pexels API is free for basic usage.

Can I customize the generated content?

FREE Version: Basic customization with company branding (your company name and details are automatically incorporated into articles).

PRO Version: Advanced customization including 11 writing styles (formal, professional, conversational, ironic, extra funny, etc.), customizable content blocks, and enhanced company branding integration.

Is the content SEO-optimized?

Yes! Both FREE and PRO versions generate SEO-optimized content.

FREE Version: Includes proper heading structure (H2, H3), keyword optimization, and basic SEO best practices.

PRO Version: Includes everything in FREE plus enhanced E-E-A-T optimization (Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness, Trustworthiness), automatic FAQ sections, and advanced SEO features.

What languages are supported?

FREE Version: English only

PRO Version: 7 languages – English, Spanish, Italian, French, Portuguese, German, and Romanian

How many articles can I generate with the FREE version?

The FREE version allows you to generate up to 20 articles per month. You can upgrade to PRO for 300 articles per month (10 per day).

What’s the difference between FREE and PRO versions?

FREE version includes Easy Article generator with basic features (20 articles/month). PRO version includes 300 articles/month, 11 writing styles, 7 languages, advanced article generator, and campaign management.

Can I upgrade to PRO later?

Yes! You can upgrade to PRO at any time by visiting https://superprogrammaticseo.ai/pricing

Do I need the SimpleTOC plugin?

SimpleTOC is optional for the FREE version. It’s recommended for better article structure.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0 (2025-12-13)

  • New: Major stable release
  • New: Campaign system fully functional in FREE version
  • Fix: Critical bug – Campaign creation form now processes correctly (fixed load order issue)
  • Fix: Campaign creation and form processing
  • Fix: Load order and missing files issues resolved
  • Fix: Removed TOC generator from FREE version (not needed, users can use SimpleTOC plugin)
  • Improved: Stability, UX, and code cleanup
  • Updated: Version bump to 1.0.0 for stable release
  • Updated: New screenshots in assets

0.9 (2025-12-07)

  • New: Campaign system implemented in FREE version (generate 1 article every 30 mins, up to 20/month).
  • New: Ownership transferred to Manuel Salazar Osorio.
  • Improved: API integrations reorganized (removed DeepSeek integration from core).
  • Updated: Enhanced campaign management features for FREE version users.

0.7.1 (2025-10-22)

  • Fixed: Critical bug where Groq API was not integrating correctly into the FREE version.
  • Fixed: Dashboard Configuration now works properly with Company Details validation.
  • Fixed: Various minor UI and saving issues in API settings and Dashboard.
  • Improved: Better configuration warnings and success messages.
  • Updated: ALL documentation, PRO limits, and FAQ sections for clarity.

0.7 (2025-10-22)

  • Initial FREE release for WordPress.org.
  • Features: Easy Article Generator, 20 articles/month, Groq AI integration, simplified Company Details, and security compliance.

0.6 (2025-08-13)

  • PRO Features added: Enhanced article generator with multiple AI providers (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, etc.), Pexels image integration, 11 writing styles, and multi-language support.

0.5 (2025-07-20)

  • Initial private PRO release.
